mapper.select: SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, o.customer_name AS customerName, o.service_type AS serviceType, o.worker_name AS workerName, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(o.order_amount, 2)) AS orderAmount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(o.paid_amount, 2)) AS paidAmount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(GREATEST(o.order_amount - o.paid_amount, 0), 2)) AS outstandingAmount, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.order_status_type AS orderStatusType, o.fulfillment_status AS fulfillmentStatus, o.fulfillment_status_type AS fulfillmentStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, latest_bill.bill_no AS billNo, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(latest_bill.bill_amount, 2)) AS billAmount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(latest_bill.paid_amount, 2)) AS billPaidAmount, latest_bill.bill_status AS billStatus, latest_bill.bill_status_type AS billStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(latest_bill.due_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS billDueAt, latest_payment.payment_order_id AS latestPaymentOrderId, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(latest_payment.amount, 2)) AS latestPaymentAmount, latest_payment.payment_method AS latestPaymentMethod, latest_payment.channel_code AS latestPaymentChannel, latest_payment.status AS latestPaymentStatus, latest_payment.status_type AS latestPaymentStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(latest_payment.success_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS latestPaymentSuccessAt, latest_prepay.prepay_order_no AS latestPrepayOrderNo, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(latest_prepay.amount, 2)) AS latestPrepayAmount, latest_prepay.pay_scene AS latestPayScene, latest_prepay.cashier_status AS latestCashierStatus, latest_prepay.cashier_status_type AS latestCashierStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(latest_prepay.expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS latestPrepayExpiresAt FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_bill latest_bill ON latest_bill.id = ( SELECT latest_b.id FROM t_bill latest_b WHERE latest_b.order_no = o.order_no ORDER BY latest_b.created_at DESC, latest_b.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN t_payment_order latest_payment ON latest_payment.id = ( SELECT latest_po.id FROM t_payment_order latest_po WHERE latest_po.order_no = o.order_no ORDER BY latest_po.created_at DESC, latest_po.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN t_prepay_order latest_prepay ON latest_prepay.id = ( SELECT latest_pr.id FROM t_prepay_order latest_pr WHERE latest_pr.order_no = o.order_no ORDER BY latest_pr.created_at DESC, latest_pr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC
